notes:
- Prospect: core product is a real-time risk scoring engine + customer chat. Heavy on low-latency chat and reranking for feed personalization.
- Primary ask: reserved GPU pools across us-east, eu-west with automatic cross-region failover; want defined headroom for failover (target 25-35% free capacity).
- Latency SLOs: p50 < 12ms, p95 < 35ms for chat generation at 8k token horizon; reranker needs p95 < 60ms at 512 tokens.
- Throughput: baseline 750 qps global steady-state, peak 1.2k qps (10-15% diurnal spikes). Need autoscale/burst plan for sudden traffic surges tied to release windows.
- GPU mix preference: A100 / H100 equivalence; evaluating mixed cluster (H100 in us-east primary, A100 in eu-west) — want transparent kernel selection and perf parity.
- Cache strategy: KV-prefetch and warmup across regions; Redwood suggested prefix caching + N=3 warm replicas — Sentinal asked for metrics on cross-region cache hit rates.
- Failover policy: stepwise routing (local AZ -> local region -> peer region) with max RTO 90s for in-flight sessions. CTO quote: "We can tolerate short degradation but need predictability and auditable failover events."
- SLA commercial: asking for 99.9% availability for dedicated capacity, with credits linked to latency SLO breaches (not just node uptime). Legal wants sample SLA + remediation mechanics.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate. Will sign a 12–24 month reservation if headroom guarantees and predictable unit pricing provided.
- POC metrics: latency p50/p95, qps sustained for 30m windows, cold-start regeneration time, KV cache hit %, cross-region failover time.
- Internal stakeholders: CTO (Lena Ortiz), Head of SRE (Amit Desai), Procurement (Claire Huang).
- Quote/request: firm quote for reserved GPU pool by 2026-02-22 incl. regional splits, burst capacity pricing, and SLA appendix.
- Notes style: lots of shorthand in calls; may need to re-confirm exact AZ pairings (us-east1-a / eu-west1-b).
requirements_summary: - Reserved GPU pools in two regions (us-east primary, eu-west failover); AZ-aware placement and automated cross-region routing. - Headroom: 25-35% reserved for failover; policy for borrowing between pools during sustained peaks. - SLOs: p50/p95 latency targets and per-route throughput guarantees. - SLA: availability + latency credits; clearly defined remediation steps. - Security: VPC peering, SAML, KMS integration, audit logs retained 1 year, regional data residency options.
po_caveats: - Procurement requires line-item for burst/overage pricing separate from committed GPUs. - Legal insists on blackout windows for maintenance; Redwood to propose maintenance windows and compensating credits. - Budget owners want optionality for on-prem hybrid later; include a clause for migration to Private deployment.
